name: productcard5
title: Shoe Size Selector Card
blurb: Shoe product card with size selector and add-to-cart button.
description: A product card with image, title, description, size selector (with hover scale), price, and CTA button with shopping cart icon. Wishlist heart toggle included.
use_when: Footwear e-commerce or product configurators where size selection and add-to-cart are primary interactions.
avoid_when: Simple product listings where size selection adds unnecessary complexity.
a11y: Size buttons are keyboard accessible with visual state. Price and product info are readable. CTA button is semantic and accessible.
